email.subject: Bright Co Dentistry: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Priya,

I checked Bright Co Dentistry's site. Two things are likely costing you new patients: it isn't optimized for mobile, and there's no tap-to-call number. Most people searching for a dentist in Harbor Falls are on their phone, and if the site is hard to use and they can't call with one tap, they just move to the next result.

I also noticed no patient reviews on the site and an outdated footer, which can make visitors second-guess booking.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
